additional_info.subject: Note to ES Team
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause
: It seems the CCS cable is faulty (possibly something loose in the Plug or water ingress).
Problem Description
: The charger is displaying a cable temperature error flag (VIV: 0, RNE: 1, KON: 1), but the error flag disappears when the customer removes the plug from the Plug holder.
Action Performed (L2)
: After rebooting, the issue reoccurs. The firmware was updated to the latest version, v6.0.3, but the issue persists. The RC partner was onsite and brought me into the call. We checked for any dirt on the CCS pin, verified the corrosion of the connector blades, and collected a short video of the plug along with pictures. We also checked the following:
Measured the voltage between the CP pin and Ground, which showed approximately 12 volts.
Measured the resistance between P1 and P2, which remained stable at approximately 1.04 kΩ even with cable movement (video attached above).
Measured the resistance between N1 and N2, which varied after the movement of the cable (video attached above).
Additionally, ES colleagues checked the resistance value while moving the gun, and a variation was also observed. The screenshot is attached in the above note.
Charger SW Version
: v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (L3)
: Further investigation required, as per the Field Issue Excel sheet.
Log Analysis with Timestamp
: 26th Feb. 9:30 AM to 2:30 PM (UTC)
Action Required by HQ
: Further investigation needed.
Attachment
: Attached the videos of the resistance & Plug pictures in the above note.
